meaning: Unwanted messages sent to lots of people at once, by email or text. Most are ads, and some try to trick you.
clues: You didn't ask for it, and it can show up in large numbers.
It is a written message, usually sent by email or text to a lot of people at once.
Most of it is ads, offers, or sales pitches.
Your phone can often filter it and block it before you see it.
Its name has four letters and starts with S.
assumes: A robocall is a spoken call, not a written message

decoys.meaning: A phone call made by a machine, often playing a recorded message.
Harmful software that gets onto your device without your knowledge. It can steal your information.
Faking the number on your caller ID so a call seems to come from another number.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A letter from a stranger asking for money went in the trash, and we never wrote back. The same rule works for a text you didn't expect: don't tap its links.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it: if a text you didn't expect shows up, forward it to 7726. This helps your phone company block similar messages.

sources.name: FTC, How to Recognize and Report Spam Text Messages
FCC, Stop Unwanted Robocalls and Texts
FTC, Malware: How To Protect Against, Detect, and Remove It
